/domain-modeling Here's the change I'm leaning toward: Invoices should belong to the Customer instead of the Account, so each Customer gets one Invoice per billing period across all of its Accounts.
Another option I'm weighing instead: keep the boundary but rename Account to Billing Profile, since people keep confusing it with a login.
